'''Enchant Crossbow Bolt (Onyx)''' is a [[Enchant Crossbow Bolt|bolt enchantment spell]] that requires a [[Magic]] level of 87 to cast. It imbues 10 [[onyx bolts]] each cast and turns them into [[onyx bolts (e)]] or 10 [[onyx dragon bolts]] into 10 [[onyx dragon bolts (e)]]. The enchantment gives the effect ''Life Leech''. This effect has a small chance to do extra damage and restore [[Hitpoints]] back to the player, but does not work on the [[undead]].
